# Project Notes (`@local/dsh-notes`)

A DSH bundle that adds a **left-sidebar page of notes pinned per project**. Notes you
switch on are

rendered into the agent's system prompt on every step, so project
conventions and personal preferenc
es stay in context without being repeated.
## What it does

- **Sidebar row** (`sidebar.panellist`, id `dsh-notes`, order 21 — right after the
host's Context ro

w) and the page it selects (`main`, key `dsh-notes`).
- **Per-project notes.** Each browser-selected

project has its own list; the
project list comes from the host's workspace registry, and any direct

ory that
already owns notes stays selectable.
- **Injection switch.** Every note has its own switch.

Only enabled, non-empty
notes are injected, and only for agents whose working directory is that pro

ject.
- **Durable store.** Notes live in `<dsh home>/notes/<profile>.json`, written
atomically (temp
file + rename) so a crash cannot truncate them.
## Architecture

**Host half** (`index.js`) injects `agents`, `systemPrompt`, `webServer`,
`workspaceRegistry` and ow

ost half** (`index.js`) injects `agents`, `systemPrompt`, `webServer`,
`workspaceRegistry` and owns:
| Concern | Extension point |

| Store | JSON file under `<dsh home>/notes/`, atomic write |
| Panel data | `webServer.register({ k

ind: 'exact' })` on `/dsh-notes/api/state` (GET) and `/dsh-notes/api/notes` (POST) |
| Standing cont
ext | one `systemPrompt.section({ name: 'dsh-notes.project-notes', order: 780 })` registered on **ea
ch agent's own context**, rendering that agent's project only |

The section is attached for agents created later (`agent/created`) *and* for
agents already live whe

n the plugin activates, so the current session starts
honouring notes immediately. Attachments are r
emoved on plugin unload.

**Client half** (`client.js`) registers the sidebar glyph and the page through
`ctx.slots.inject(slo

t, () => ctx.slots.register(...))`, so both disappear with
the host's declaration. Host calls go thr

ough `document.baseURI`-relative URLs.
Styling uses `--dsw-alias-*` tokens only, so the page follows

nt.baseURI`-relative URLs.
Styling uses `--dsw-alias-*` tokens only, so the page follows light/dark.
## Behaviour notes

- A project with no enabled notes adds **no** text: the system prompt is unchanged.
- Notes are prom

pt input, not session history — editing one affects the next
request and never rewrites the log.
- T

he page saves on a 450 ms debounce and flushes pending keystrokes on unmount
and on project switch.
## Develop

The install links this directory, so edits apply without reinstalling:
reload the page (Ctrl+R) afte

r changing `client.js`; Host changes (`index.js`)
need a Harness restart.
